matching_entry:
Showdown (Trunks Saga - #P10) - Allies may not do anything while this affect of this card is
floating. This means that an ally cannot take control of Combat, cannot pay costs for cards,
use their powers, or have damage redirected to them.
applied_interpretation: Showdown disables every use of an Ally, including taking over Combat, paying costs, powers, and redirected damage. Its display wording retains the broad Allies prohibition; no invented banishment or attack restriction.
other_card_specific_updates: No matching card-specific entries for P6, P7, P8 or P9.
